description:
ROOT CAUSE FOUND for the glyph-box reports (supersedes bd-515's hypotheses).

Diagnosed 2026-08-28 with kpdf-doctor against a maintainer-supplied form workbook (copyrighted, NOT committed; only aggregate facts recorded here).

Numbers from that document:
  51 font instances -> embed=none  -> NO OUTLINES -> drawn as advance boxes
  29 font instances -> embed=FontFile2 -> render correctly

Every boxed font is NON-EMBEDDED: ArialMT, Arial-BoldMT, Arial-ItalicMT, TimesNewRomanPSMT (all /Subtype /TrueType, no /FontFile*). Every font the document DOES embed renders fine.

So this is NOT a decoder failure. bd-515 assumed the boxes came from failing to decode an EMBEDDED program (CID-keyed CFF / seac / predefined-Expert encoding). Here there is nothing to decode at all: the PDF names a standard font and expects the viewer to supply it, per PDF 32000-1:2008 s9.6.2.2 (the standard-14) and s9.8.2 for descriptor-based substitution. kopitiam-pdf has no substitution path, so Font::outline_source() is None and the draw device emits a filled advance box per glyph.

This is extremely common: Word/LibreOffice-produced forms and reports routinely reference Arial/Times without embedding. Any such document is currently unreadable in kpdf.

WHAT IS NEEDED
- A substitution path: map a non-embedded font to a bundled face by descriptor (/Flags serif/fixed-pitch/symbolic, /FontFamily, /ItalicAngle, /StemV) and by the standard-14 names, then select glyphs by unicode rather than GID.
- A bundled, redistributable face. Licence must be AGPL-compatible; OFL-1.1 ships alongside per docs/ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md. Metric compatibility with Helvetica/Times matters for layout (widths come from /Widths, so a mismatched face reflows badly).
- Termux/Android has no system font-fallback chain to lean on (already noted in CLAUDE.md), so bundling is the portable answer rather than probing system fonts.

Note the hayro cross-engine fallback (176c52b) does not rescue this: it re-renders when OUR device hits the box fallback, but hayro needs its own substitute fonts for a non-embedded face too. Worth measuring what hayro actually produces on such a page before designing ours.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
RESOLVED 2026-08-28 (commit a862733).

Ported hayro-interpret 0.7.0's select_standard_font heuristic (pub(crate) upstream, so ported not called) and reused its bundled Foxit base-14 font data via the public StandardFont::get_font_data(). All 14 faces available and test-asserted to parse and yield outlines through our own glyph_cff decoder — the .pfb files are actually bare CFF.

Selection is by glyph NAME, never the document's GIDs (which index a program we do not have). An unrecognised font is refused rather than guessed at.

Verified on the maintainer's workbook: 51 fonts with no outlines -> 0, and at the rasteriser fallback_glyphs = 0 on pages 1/5/25 with real ink. A rendered page was visually confirmed clean, then deleted (copyrighted material, never committed).

Remaining ceiling tracked separately as gh-95: no AFM widths when a PDF omits /Widths entirely.

title: kopitiam-pdf: no substitution for NON-EMBEDDED fonts -- every glyph becomes an advance box
